background_setting: A two-lane road at the edge of a small town under clear daytime skies. The asphalt is dry with faint lane markings and a solid or dashed center line. On the right sits a roadside SPEED LIMIT 30 sign, and behind it an open commercial lot holds a large advertising trailer bearing a bold '70' promotion. Low buildings, storefronts, scattered trees, utility poles, and a few parked vehicles line the periphery. The road ahead is clear and unobstructed, receding toward a bright horizon.
